project_resolution.basis: The most recent persistent X-ray project candidate with a nonempty saved X-ray batch state; the saved batch is a prediction review with 13 entries and position 3.
project_resolution.identity_caveat: The active X-ray project root is held by the running module instance and is not written to the global recent-project preference. The preference currently points to an unavailable temporary test project, so live-process binding could not be independently confirmed.

code_findings.structures_label_condition: XRayStructureWorkspace._update_active_structure displays No structures when _structure() returns None; _build_structure_buttons chooses the first active-scheme structure or None.
code_findings.specimen_list_condition: XRayStructureWorkspace.refresh obtains rows independently through project.structure_specimens; this query filters confirmed specimen crops and does not require scheme structures.
code_findings.diagnosis: The matched project's active scheme is empty, which explains No structures while confirmed fish/specimen rows remain visible. This is data state, not a UI rendering bug.
code_findings.cross_stage_selection: Crops.selected_image_id/session.selected_id and Structures.selected_specimen_id are workspace-local fields. XRayCountsRuntime creates each workspace separately; no common current-specimen state is saved or propagated.
